title: Three-region mass estimate for the comparison current (parent steps 4–7; Simon 7.2.4 (8)–(11))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, W, F, B ⊆ ℝ^P, T, Z ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and C, S, Ŷ, Sr, Y ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n). Let R be an integer multiplicity representation of T in U (IMRep U n with R.Represents T), μ_T := R.measure, and let e ∈ [0, ∞]. Assume: Z is integer multiplicity; B is open and B ⊆ U; W is open, F is compact and W ⊆ F ⊆ B; μ_T(F ∖ W) = 0; spt(S − C) ⊆ W; Ŷ is integer multiplicity with spt Ŷ ⊆ F; μ_{R′}(F ∖ W) ≤ e for every integer multiplicity representation R′ of Ŷ in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n); M(Sr) ≤ e; C(ω) = currentEval(T, ω) + Ŷ(ω) + Sr(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) with tsupport ω ⊆ W; Y(ω) = (S − C)(ω) + Ŷ(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P); and Z(ω) = T(ω) + Y(ιω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), where ιω = testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) n ω. Then there is b ∈ [0, ∞] with M_B(T) = M_W(T) + b and M_B(Z) ≤ M_W(S) + e + e + b. Here M_G(A) = A.massOn G is the local mass in [0, ∞] (supremum of ofReal(A(ω)) over test forms ω of the domain of A with tsupport ω ⊆ G and Euclidean coefficient norm ≤ 1); M(Sr) = Sr.mass = M_{ℝ^P}(Sr); currentEval(T, ω) (contract currentEval) is T(ω) if ω is a test form with tsupport ω ⊆ U, and 0 otherwise; spt is GeometricCurrentOn.support and (S − C)(ω) = S(ω) − C(ω).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W F B : Set (Euclid P)) (T Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (C S Ŷ Sr Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (e : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → IsIntegerMultiplicity Z → IsOpen B → B ⊆ U → IsOpen W → IsCompact F → W ⊆ F → F ⊆ B → R.measure (F \ W) = 0 → (S - C).support ⊆ W → IsIntegerMultiplicity Ŷ → Ŷ.support ⊆ F → (∀ R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R'.Represents Ŷ → R'.measure (F \ W) ≤ e) → Sr.mass ≤ e → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ W → C ω = currentEval T (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) + Ŷ ω + Sr ω) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Y ω = (S - C) ω + Ŷ ω) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Z ω = T ω + Y (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) n ω)) → ∃ b : ℝ≥0∞, T.massOn B = T.massOn W + b ∧ Z.massOn B ≤ S.massOn W + e + e + b
